title: record_deployment input
description: Records that an artifact version reached a target, as reported by the owner's AI tool. The engine sets the route and computes the flags and the gate level; the caller cannot set them. Give exactly one of deploymentTargetId and targetExternalId. The same contract serves the pipeline record endpoint (record-endpoint.json).
$comment: WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 7). Reported code approvals are evidence only. AI-only code approvals never count as authorization, and the shipped gate default flags them. WORKING DEFAULT (open design question 12). Pipelines do not use MCP. They call the record endpoint with this contract, as a workload identity that holds the deployment recorder role through a Workload Grant (C42). idempotencyKey replaces clientRequestId for this tool (document 24, section 3.6).

idempotencyKey.description: The sender's retry key, such as run ID plus stage plus attempt. The record is upserted by this key, so a retry never creates a second row (I-189).

businessApplicationId.description: The application, when the sender knows it. Otherwise the engine resolves it from the pipeline map.

artifactName.description: The artifact's name, such as a solution unique name or an image name.

artifactKindKey.description: From the artifact kind value list.

digest.description: The artifact's hash, when the sender has one.

sourceCommit.description: The source commit the artifact was built from.

deploymentTargetId.description: The target by its row ID.

targetExternalId.description: The target's ID in its own tool, matched to the Deployment Target External Id.

changeRequestId.description: The change this deployment belongs to, if known. Without it the engine matches an open change for the same application and target whose window covers finishedOn.

pipelineReferenceId.description: The pipeline that ran, by its row ID.

resultMeaning.description: How it ended. An abandoned run is not-deployed.

versionBefore.description: The version read on the target before.

versionAfter.description: The version read on the target after.

deployedByObjectId.description: Who deployed, as reported. Leave out for the caller.

mergeActorObjectId.description: Who completed the merge that triggered the run, as reported.

mergeActorKind.description: The actor kind of the merge actor, as reported, so an AI merge is visible.

stageOrderRun.description: The pipeline stages actually run, in order.

codeApprovalKind.description: Who approved the code merge. Evidence only.

approverKind.description: Whether a person or an AI approved.

sourceUrl.description: Where the approval shows, such as the pull request.

reportedApprovals.description: Code approvals the sender reports. Stored as evidence (Reported Approvals Json). They never count toward the product's approval rules.
